functions.name: apache::thrift::protocol::TMultiplexedProtocol::TMultiplexedProtocol
functions.description: Constructs a TMultiplexedProtocol that decorates the given TProtocol to communicate with a multiplexing server by prefixing the service name to each outgoing RPC method name. Use this when multiple Thrift services share the same transport/protocol on the client side.
requirements: _protocol must be a valid, initialized TProtocol instance (non-null), suitable for writing messages.
_serviceName is the logical service identifier to prefix to each method; it should match the name registered on the multiplexing server.
Open the underlying transport of the wrapped protocol before issuing RPCs (typical Thrift requirement).
Use with a multiplexing-aware server (e.g., TMultiplexedProcessor) on the other end for correct routing.

functions.name: apache::thrift::protocol::TMultiplexedProtocol::~TMultiplexedProtocol
functions.description: Destructor for TMultiplexedProtocol. Defaulted; releases any resources owned by the decorator. Underlying protocol is held by shared_ptr and is not explicitly closed here.
requirements: No special requirements for callers; typical C++ object lifetime semantics apply.
Do not use the object after destruction.

functions.name: apache::thrift::protocol::TMultiplexedProtocol::writeMessageBegin_virt
functions.signature: uint32_t apache::thrift::protocol::TMultiplexedProtocol::writeMessageBegin_virt(const std::string& _name, const apache::thrift::protocol::TMessageType _type, const int32_t _seqid)
functions.description: Begins writing a Thrift message by prepending the configured service name and a colon separator to the provided method name, then delegating to the wrapped protocol. Intended for client-side use with a multiplexing server. Propagates exceptions from the underlying TProtocol.
requirements: Call as part of the normal Thrift message write sequence before writing fields, per TProtocol contract.
_name should be the bare method name (without any service prefix); the decorator will add the service name automatically.
_type must be a valid apache::thrift::protocol::TMessageType value corresponding to the message being sent.
_seqid should be the sequential message id used by the client to correlate requests and responses; maintain consistency with subsequent writes/reads.
Underlying wrapped protocol must be valid and open/ready for writing.
Caller must be prepared to handle apache::thrift::TException thrown by the wrapped protocol.

functions.name: apache::thrift::protocol::base64_encode
functions.signature: void apache::thrift::protocol::base64_encode(const uint8_t* in, uint32_t len, uint8_t* buf)
functions.description: Encodes up to three raw bytes into four Base64-encoded bytes (ASCII values) without '=' padding. Intended to be called repeatedly on chunks of size 1–3 bytes; the caller is responsible for concatenating outputs and adding '=' padding if desired. Output is written to the provided buffer; the input and output buffers must not overlap. No NUL terminator is written.
requirements: in must point to at least len readable bytes.
len must be 1, 2, or 3.
buf must point to a writable buffer of at least 4 bytes.
buf must not overlap with in (no in-place encoding).
The function does not add '=' padding; the caller must add padding if needed.
The function does not NUL-terminate output; the caller must manage string termination if treating output as a C-string.

functions.name: apache::thrift::protocol::base64_decode
functions.description: Decodes 2–4 Base64-encoded input bytes (ASCII values) in-place into the corresponding 1–3 raw bytes. The same buffer is used for input and output: it must initially contain 2–4 valid Base64 characters with no '=' padding; after the call, the beginning of the buffer holds the decoded bytes. Intended to be called repeatedly on consecutive Base64 quartets/triples/pairs; caller manages aggregation and any padding handling externally.
requirements: buf must point to a buffer of at least 4 bytes that initially contains Base64-encoded input values.
len is the number of input bytes to consume and must be 2, 3, or 4.
No '=' padding should be included in the input.
The function overwrites buf with the decoded output (in-place).
The function does not NUL-terminate output; the caller must manage string termination if needed.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::readAll
functions.signature:
template <class Transport_>
uint32_t apache::thrift::transport::readAll(Transport_& trans, uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len)
functions.description: Reads exactly len bytes from the given transport into buf by repeatedly calling trans.read() until the requested length is satisfied. Throws TTransportException(END_OF_FILE) if no more data is available before len bytes are read. Typically used by higher-level code to guarantee a full read.
requirements: trans must provide a read(uint8_t*, uint32_t) method that returns the number of bytes read or throws on error.
buf must point to a writable memory region of at least len bytes.
len may be 0; if > 0, the transport must eventually return >0 bytes per read to avoid END_OF_FILE.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::isOpen
functions.description: Indicates whether the transport is open. Base implementation returns false; concrete transports should override to report actual open state.
requirements: May be called at any time; no side effects expected.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::peek
functions.description: Tests whether more data may be read or the remote side is still open. Default implementation returns isOpen(). Implementations may add transport-specific checks (e.g., socket readiness). Commonly used by servers to decide whether to wait for another request.
requirements: No specific argument/state requirements; behavior depends on the concrete transport's override.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::open
functions.description: Opens the transport for communication. Base implementation always throws TTransportException(NOT_OPEN). Concrete transports must override to perform the actual open.
requirements: Call only on a transport that is not already open (typical for concrete implementations).
Caller must handle TTransportException on failure.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::close
functions.description: Closes the transport. Base implementation always throws TTransportException(NOT_OPEN). Concrete transports must override to perform the actual close.
requirements: Caller must handle TTransportException on failure.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::read
functions.description: Attempts to read up to len bytes into buf by dispatching to read_virt(). Returns the number of bytes actually read. May throw TTransportException on error. This is the non-virtual entry point that enforces the virtual call site (via T_VIRTUAL_CALL macro) and then calls the virtual implementation.
requirements: buf must point to a writable memory region of at least len bytes.
len is the maximum number of bytes to read; may be 0.
Transport must be open and readable; otherwise read_virt() is expected to throw TTransportException.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::read_virt
functions.description: Virtual implementation of read(). Base implementation throws TTransportException(NOT_OPEN, "Base TTransport cannot read."). Concrete transports must override to supply bytes.
requirements: If overridden, must return the number of bytes read (0 is typically EOF depending on the transport).
If the transport is not open or an error occurs, should throw TTransportException.
buf must be valid for writing up to len bytes when len > 0.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::readAll
functions.description: Reads exactly len bytes into buf by dispatching to readAll_virt(). Throws on insufficient data. Provided for callers that need a full-length read.
requirements: buf must point to a writable memory region of at least len bytes.
len may be 0; if > 0, underlying transport must be able to eventually provide len bytes or an exception will be thrown.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::readAll_virt
functions.description: Virtual implementation of readAll(). Default implementation delegates to apache::thrift::transport::readAll(*this, buf, len), which repeatedly calls read() until len bytes are obtained or throws END_OF_FILE.
requirements: If overridden, must read exactly len bytes or throw on insufficient data.
buf must be valid for writing at least len bytes.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::readEnd
functions.description: Hook called when a read operation is completed. Default does nothing and returns 0. Implementations may override to perform transport-specific actions (e.g., logging) and optionally return bytes read.
requirements: May be called after a read/readAll operation; semantics are transport-specific.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::write
functions.description: Writes len bytes from buf by dispatching to write_virt(). Note that flush() must be called to ensure data is actually written out when using buffered transports; destruction of the transport does not imply flushing.
requirements: buf must point to a readable memory region of at least len bytes.
len may be 0.
Caller should call flush() to ensure pending data is written when required by the transport.
Transport must be open and writable; otherwise write_virt() is expected to throw TTransportException.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::write_virt
functions.signature: virtual void apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::write_virt(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len)
functions.description: Virtual implementation of write(). Base implementation throws TTransportException(NOT_OPEN, "Base TTransport cannot write."). Concrete transports must override to accept and buffer/write bytes.
requirements: If overridden, must write/accept exactly len bytes or throw on error as appropriate for the transport.
buf must be valid for reading len bytes when len > 0.
Should throw TTransportException on failures or if the transport is not open.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::writeEnd
functions.description: Hook called when a write operation is completed. Default does nothing and returns 0. Implementations may override to perform transport-specific end-of-request actions and optionally return bytes written.
requirements: May be called after a write/flush operation; semantics are transport-specific.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::flush
functions.description: Flushes any pending data to be written. Default implementation does nothing. Buffered transports should override to push buffered data to the underlying medium.
requirements: Call after write() to ensure data is actually written for buffered transports.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::borrow
functions.description: Attempts to return a pointer to len bytes without consuming them, possibly using buf as temporary storage. If successful, returns a pointer to the borrowed data (which may be buf or an internal buffer) and sets *len to the available byte count (at least the requested amount). If borrowing fails, returns nullptr and the contents of *len are undefined. Intended for protocols that need to inspect variable-length data before consuming it.
requirements: len must be a valid, non-null pointer to an input size and output available-size value.
buf may be nullptr to request a pointer into an internal buffer if available; if not nullptr and borrow returns a different pointer, the contents of buf after the call are undefined.
On success, caller should subsequently call consume(n) to remove the bytes actually used.
Caller must be prepared to fall back to read() if borrow fails.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::borrow_virt
functions.signature: virtual const uint8_t* apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::borrow_virt(uint8_t* buf, uint32_t* len)
functions.description: Virtual implementation of borrow(). Base implementation returns nullptr, indicating borrowing is unsupported. Transports that support peeking without consuming should override.
requirements: If overridden, must follow the borrow contract: on success return a valid pointer and set *len to the available size (>= requested); on failure may return nullptr and leave *len unspecified.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::consume
functions.description: Consumes (removes) len bytes from the transport following a successful borrow of at least len bytes by dispatching to consume_virt().
requirements: Must be called only after a successful borrow of at least len bytes.
len is the number of bytes to remove; may be 0.
Transport should be open; otherwise consume_virt() is expected to throw TTransportException.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::consume_virt
functions.description: Virtual implementation of consume(). Base implementation throws TTransportException(NOT_OPEN, "Base TTransport cannot consume."). Transports that support borrow must override to advance their read position.
requirements: If overridden, must succeed when called after a borrow of at least len bytes; should throw TTransportException on error or invalid state.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::getOrigin
functions.description: Returns a string describing the origin of the transport call (e.g., client IP for socket-based transports). Base implementation returns "Unknown".
requirements: No specific requirements; return value is transport-dependent.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::getConfiguration
functions.description: Returns the configuration object associated with this transport.
requirements: None.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::setConfiguration
functions.description: Sets the configuration object for this transport if config is non-null; otherwise leaves the current configuration unchanged.
requirements: config must be non-null to take effect; passing nullptr is a no-op.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::updateKnownMessageSize
functions.description: Updates the internal known and remaining message sizes to the real message length (e.g., when using framed transport). Throws if previously consumed bytes exceed the new size or if the new size is larger than the previously known maximum.
requirements: size must be greater than or equal to the number of bytes already consumed by the current message.
size must be less than or or equal to the previous known message size; message size can shrink but not grow.
On violation, a TTransportException(END_OF_FILE, "MaxMessageSize reached") is thrown.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransport::checkReadBytesAvailable
functions.description: Checks that numBytes bytes are available in the current message according to the remaining message size; throws TTransportException(END_OF_FILE) if not enough bytes remain or if numBytes is negative.
requirements: numBytes must be >= 0.
numBytes must be <= the transport's internal remaining message size at the time of the call.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransportFactory::getTransport
functions.description: Factory method that returns a transport derived from the input transport. Default implementation returns the transport passed in. Frequently overridden by servers to wrap a raw client transport with input/output transports.
requirements: None specific in the base class; behavior depends on overrides. The returned transport may be the same as trans.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransportException::TTransportException
functions.description: Default constructor for TTransportException. Initializes the exception with type UNKNOWN and no message. Use when you want to throw a generic transport error and set details later.
requirements: No arguments required.
Constructed object is valid with type() == UNKNOWN.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransportException::getType
functions.description: Returns the transport exception type code associated with this exception. Use to branch error handling based on the error category.
requirements: Callable on a valid TTransportException instance.
No exceptions will be thrown (noexcept).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TTransportException::what
functions.description: Returns a C-string describing the exception. Overrides std::exception::what. The string is owned by the exception object and remains valid as long as the exception object lives.
requirements: Callable on a valid TTransportException instance.
Do not free or modify the returned pointer; its lifetime is tied to the exception object.
No exceptions will be thrown (noexcept).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::safe_numeric_cast
functions.signature:
template <typename To, typename From>
To apache::thrift::transport::safe_numeric_cast(From i)
functions.description: Safely casts a numeric value from type From to type To using boost::numeric_cast. On overflow/underflow or invalid conversion, it throws a TTransportException with type CORRUPTED_DATA, carrying the underlying cast error message. Use for defensive numeric conversions in transport code to enforce overflow checks.
requirements: Template parameters To and From must denote types supported by boost::numeric_cast (typically arithmetic/numeric types).
Caller must be prepared to handle apache::thrift::transport::TTransportException on failed conversions (e.g., out-of-range).
Argument 'i' should be a value convertible from From to To via boost::numeric_cast; otherwise an exception will be thrown.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TNullTransport::isOpen
functions.description: Returns true for the null transport. This dummy transport is always considered open and accepts writes that are discarded.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TNullTransport::open
functions.description: No-op for the null transport. Provided for API compatibility; it neither changes state nor throws.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TNullTransport::write
functions.description: Accepts data and discards it (like /dev/null). Intended for testing or disabling output paths while preserving call sites.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf should point to at least len bytes of readable memory (standard C/C++ contract for write-like APIs).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::isOpen
functions.description: Returns the open state of the source transport being wrapped/piped. TPipedTransport proxies most operations to the source transport while optionally piping data to a destination transport.
requirements: Source transport (srcTrans_) must be non-null and properly constructed before calling.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::peek
functions.description: Checks if there is data available to read, filling an internal expandable read buffer from the source transport if needed. May grow the internal buffer and perform a non-blocking read attempt via srcTrans_->read.
requirements: Source transport must be open before calling.
May allocate or reallocate internal buffers; callers should be prepared for std::bad_alloc exceptions on allocation failure.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::open
functions.description: Opens the underlying source transport. TPipedTransport itself holds no additional resources that need opening.
requirements: Semantics and failure modes are those of the underlying source transport’s open().
Should not be called if the source transport does not support reopening or is already open, unless that transport permits it.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::close
functions.description: Closes the underlying source transport. Does not close the destination transport.
requirements: Semantics and failure modes are those of the underlying source transport’s close().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::setPipeOnRead
functions.description: Enables or disables piping buffered request data to the destination transport when readEnd() is called. Default is enabled (true).
requirements: Destination transport (dstTrans_) must be non-null and usable if piping is enabled.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::setPipeOnWrite
functions.description: Enables or disables piping of the data accumulated via write() to the destination transport when writeEnd() is called. Default is disabled (false).
requirements: Destination transport (dstTrans_) must be non-null and usable if piping is enabled.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::read
functions.description: Reads up to len bytes from the internal read buffer (fed from the source transport) into buf, updating internal position. Behavior is consistent with TTransport::read semantics.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of writable memory.
Source transport must be open and readable.
Return value indicates number of bytes read; caller should handle short reads per TTransport contract.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::readEnd
functions.description: Signals the end of a read operation. If pipe-on-read is enabled, writes the bytes consumed from the internal read buffer to the destination transport and flushes it, then forwards readEnd() to the source transport. Preserves any read-ahead data.
requirements: Destination transport must be writable if pipe-on-read is enabled; may throw if dstTrans_ write/flush fails.
Source transport must support readEnd(); errors from srcTrans_->readEnd() propagate.
Returns the number of bytes consumed since the last readEnd().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::write
functions.description: Appends len bytes from buf to an internal expandable write buffer. If pipe-on-write is enabled, data will be emitted to the destination transport on writeEnd().
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of readable memory.
May allocate or reallocate internal buffers; callers should be prepared for std::bad_alloc on allocation failure.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::writeEnd
functions.description: If pipe-on-write is enabled, writes the accumulated write buffer to the destination transport and flushes it. Returns the number of bytes accumulated. Does not automatically clear the internal buffer per header; behavior of clearing is defined in implementation.
requirements: Destination transport must be writable if pipe-on-write is enabled; errors propagate from dstTrans_->write/flush().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::flush
functions.description: Flushes the source transport (and possibly interacts with internal buffers in the implementation). The exact behavior is defined by the implementation; typically forwards to srcTrans_->flush().
requirements: Source transport must be open; errors propagate from the underlying transport.
Exact flushing semantics are unknown from this header; callers should not rely on flushing to trigger piping unless using readEnd()/writeEnd().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::getTargetTransport
functions.description: Returns the destination transport to which data may be piped during readEnd() or writeEnd().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::read_virt
functions.description: Virtual dispatch shim that calls TPipedTransport::read. Required because TPipedTransport inherits TTransport virtually and cannot use TVirtualTransport helpers.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of writable memory.
Same preconditions as read().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::write_virt
functions.signature: void apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransport::write_virt(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len) override
functions.description: Virtual dispatch shim that calls TPipedTransport::write. Required because of virtual inheritance layout.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of readable memory.
Same preconditions as write().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransportFactory::getTransport
functions.description: Wraps the provided source transport in a TPipedTransport that pipes to the factory’s destination transport.
requirements: initializeTargetTransport(dstTrans) must have been called (or constructor provided) before first use; otherwise dstTrans_ is null and TPipedTransport will be constructed with a null destination which will fail when piping is enabled.
srcTrans must be non-null and otherwise valid for wrapping.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedTransportFactory::initializeTargetTransport
functions.description: Sets the destination transport used by transports created from this factory. Can only be called once; subsequent calls throw a TException.
requirements: Must be called at most once; calling when dstTrans_ is already set throws TException("Target transport already initialized").
dstTrans must be non-null and appropriately initialized/opened as required by its use.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::isOpen
functions.description: Returns whether the underlying file reader source transport is open. This specialization of TPipedTransport also implements TFileReaderTransport.
requirements: Underlying file reader transport (srcTrans_) must be valid.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::peek
functions.description: Checks if data is available to read, using internal buffering and the underlying file reader source transport.
requirements: Source file reader transport must be open.
May allocate/reallocate internal buffers; callers should handle std::bad_alloc.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::open
functions.description: Opens the underlying file reader source transport.
requirements: Semantics and errors mirror those of the underlying TFileReaderTransport::open().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::close
functions.description: Closes the underlying file reader source transport.
requirements: Semantics and errors mirror those of the underlying TFileReaderTransport::close().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::read
functions.description: Reads up to len bytes from the internal buffer/source file reader transport into buf. Integrates with piping behavior on readEnd().
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of writable memory.
Source transport must be open; short reads are possible.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::readAll
functions.description: Attempts to read exactly len bytes into buf, blocking or looping as needed per TTransport::readAll semantics, using the underlying file reader transport.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of writable memory.
May throw on EOF/short read depending on underlying transport’s contract.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::readEnd
functions.description: Signals the end of a read; if pipe-on-read is enabled, writes consumed data to the destination transport and flushes it, then forwards readEnd() to the source file reader transport. Preserves any read-ahead data.
requirements: Destination transport must be writable if pipe-on-read is enabled; errors propagate.
Source file reader transport must support readEnd().
Returns the number of bytes consumed since last readEnd().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::write
functions.description: Appends len bytes from buf to the internal write buffer. If pipe-on-write is enabled, data is emitted to the destination transport on writeEnd().
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of readable memory.
May allocate/reallocate internal buffers; callers should handle std::bad_alloc.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::writeEnd
functions.description: If pipe-on-write is enabled, writes the accumulated write buffer to the destination transport and flushes it. Returns the number of bytes accumulated.
requirements: Destination transport must be writable if pipe-on-write is enabled; errors propagate from write/flush.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::flush
functions.description: Flushes buffered output per the underlying transports’ semantics. Typically forwards to the source transport’s flush; exact behavior is implementation-defined.
requirements: Source transport must be open; errors propagate from underlying transport.
Do not rely on flush to trigger piping; use readEnd()/writeEnd() for that behavior.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::getReadTimeout
functions.description: Returns the read timeout (in milliseconds) from the underlying file reader transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::setReadTimeout
functions.description: Sets the read timeout (in milliseconds) on the underlying file reader transport.
requirements: readTimeout should be non-negative; exact constraints depend on underlying transport (not specified here).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::getNumChunks
functions.description: Returns the number of chunks in the underlying file reader transport (useful for chunked file access semantics).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::getCurChunk
functions.description: Returns the current chunk index in the underlying file reader transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::seekToChunk
functions.description: Seeks the underlying file reader transport to the specified chunk index.
requirements: chunk must be a valid chunk index as defined by the underlying TFileReaderTransport; behavior for out-of-range values is implementation-defined (not specified here).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::seekToEnd
functions.description: Seeks the underlying file reader transport to the end.
requirements: Underlying transport must support seeking; otherwise behavior is transport-defined.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::read_virt
functions.description: Virtual dispatch shim that calls TPipedFileReaderTransport::read.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of writable memory.
Same preconditions as read().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::readAll_virt
functions.description: Virtual dispatch shim that calls TPipedFileReaderTransport::readAll.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of writable memory.
Same preconditions as readAll().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::write_virt
functions.signature: void apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransport::write_virt(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len) override
functions.description: Virtual dispatch shim that calls TPipedFileReaderTransport::write.
requirements: > If len > 0, buf must point to at least len bytes of readable memory.
Same preconditions as write().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransportFactory::getTransport
functions.description: If srcTrans is a TFileReaderTransport, wraps it with TPipedFileReaderTransport that pipes to the factory’s destination transport; otherwise returns a null shared_ptr.
requirements: initializeTargetTransport(dstTrans) must have been called (or constructor provided) before use; otherwise resulting piped transport will have a null destination and will fail when piping is enabled.
srcTrans must be a TFileReaderTransport (checked via dynamic_pointer_cast) to be wrapped; otherwise callers must handle a null return.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TPipedFileReaderTransportFactory::getFileReaderTransport
functions.description: Wraps the given TFileReaderTransport into a TPipedFileReaderTransport that pipes to the factory’s destination transport.
requirements: srcTrans must be non-null and valid.
Factory’s destination transport must be initialized and suitable for writes when piping is enabled.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferBase::read
functions.description: Fast-path read from the internal read buffer into the caller-provided buffer. If enough data is buffered, performs a single memcpy and advances the read pointer; otherwise defers to readSlow implemented by a subclass.
requirements: buf must be a valid writable pointer to at least len bytes when len > 0.
len may be 0 (no-op).
The transport must be open/usable per the concrete subclass’ rules.
May throw per the underlying slow-path implementation (e.g., transport errors).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferBase::readAll
functions.description: Optimized version of readAll that first attempts a fast-path memcpy if the requested len is fully available; otherwise falls back to apache::thrift::transport::readAll(*this, ...), which repeatedly reads until len bytes are obtained or an error occurs.
requirements: buf must be a valid writable pointer to at least len bytes when len > 0.
len may be 0 (no-op).
May block or throw depending on underlying transport if data is not immediately available.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferBase::write
functions.description: Fast-path write from caller-provided data into the internal write buffer. If enough space exists, performs a single memcpy and advances the write pointer; otherwise defers to writeSlow implemented by a subclass.
requirements: buf must be a valid readable pointer to at least len bytes when len > 0.
len may be 0 (no-op).
The concrete subclass must eventually flush/forward buffered data via writeSlow/flush as appropriate.
May throw per underlying transport on errors.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferBase::borrow
functions.description: Fast-path zero-copy read access to the current readable region. If at least *len bytes are available, returns a pointer into the internal buffer and sets *len to the available contiguous bytes; otherwise defers to borrowSlow.
requirements: len must be a valid non-null pointer to an input desired length; on return it is updated to the contiguous readable size.
If the fast-path succeeds, returned pointer refers to internal storage valid until consume() advances past it or internal buffers change.
POSTCONDITION for slow path: return == nullptr || rBound_ - rBase_ >= *len (as documented).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferBase::consume
functions.description: Advances the read pointer by len bytes to indicate consumption of previously borrowed/read data. Throws if attempting to consume more than the available buffered data.
requirements: len must be less than or equal to the currently available buffered bytes (rBound_ - rBase_).
consume must follow a successful borrow/read of at least len bytes; otherwise BAD_ARGS is thrown.
May throw TTransportException(TTransportException::BAD_ARGS) if len exceeds available.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::TBufferedTransport
functions.description: Constructs a buffered transport that wraps an underlying transport, using default-sized read and write buffers. Initializes internal buffers and pointers.
requirements: transport must be non-null and represent a usable underlying transport when opened.
config may be null (uses defaults).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::open
functions.description: Opens the underlying transport.
requirements: Underlying transport_ must be set; open may throw if the underlying transport fails to open.
Should be called before read/write operations that require an open transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::isOpen
functions.description: Returns whether the underlying transport is open.
requirements: None beyond having a valid underlying transport_ pointer.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::peek
functions.description: Returns true if data is available to read. If the local read buffer is empty, attempts to read from the underlying transport into the read buffer.
requirements: Underlying transport must be open or able to provide data; may block or throw based on underlying read.
May throw from transport_->read on error.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::close
functions.description: Flushes any pending buffered writes and closes the underlying transport.
requirements: If flush fails, close may throw from flush/underlying transport.
Safe to call when not open; behavior depends on underlying transport but typical is idempotent close.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::readSlow
functions.description: Slow-path read implementation used when the fast path cannot satisfy the request. Reads from the underlying transport into the internal buffer and/or directly into buf as needed.
requirements: buf must be writable for at least len bytes when len > 0.
Underlying transport must be usable/open; may block or throw on errors.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::writeSlow
functions.description: Slow-path write called when the internal write buffer lacks space. Typically flushes the buffer to the underlying transport and/or grows/copies remaining bytes.
requirements: buf must be readable for at least len bytes when len > 0.
Underlying transport must be usable/open; may throw on write/flush errors.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::flush
functions.description: Flushes the buffered write data to the underlying transport.
requirements: Underlying transport must be open/usable; may throw on I/O error.
Should be called to ensure data is sent promptly or before close().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::getOrigin
functions.description: Returns the origin string reported by the underlying transport.
requirements: Underlying transport must be present; forwards to transport_->getOrigin().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::borrowSlow
functions.description: Slow-path implementation for zero-copy borrow when insufficient data is buffered. May read from the underlying transport and expose a contiguous region or return nullptr.
requirements: len must be a valid pointer; on return either nullptr or at least *len bytes are available as per the documented postcondition.
May block or throw depending on underlying transport behavior.

Behavioral notes documented: if len <= rBufSize_, borrow will never return nullptr, but may throw/hang depending on underlying transport; if len <= rBufSize_/2, copied bytes will not be re-copied for optimal performance.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::getUnderlyingTransport
functions.description: Returns the wrapped underlying transport instance.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::readAll
functions.description: Uses TBufferBase::readAll to read exactly len bytes into buf, leveraging any available buffered data first.
requirements: buf must be writable for len bytes.
May block or throw based on underlying transport behavior.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransport::readEnd
functions.description: Marks the end of a read message/frame for accounting and resets consumed message size. Returns 0 for compatibility.
requirements: Should be called after completing a message read if using message-size accounting.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransportFactory::TBufferedTransportFactory
functions.description: Default constructor for the buffered transport factory.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransportFactory::~TBufferedTransportFactory
functions.description: Defaulted destructor for the buffered transport factory.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TBufferedTransportFactory::getTransport
functions.description: Wraps the provided transport in a new TBufferedTransport instance and returns it.
requirements: trans must be non-null and represent a valid transport to be wrapped.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::TFramedTransport
functions.description: Constructs a framed transport without an underlying transport set yet, allocating a default write buffer and preparing to prefix frames with length.
requirements: config may be null (uses defaults).
Caller must set/ensure an underlying transport before I/O operations that require it.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::open
functions.description: Opens the underlying transport.
requirements: Underlying transport_ must be set; may throw if opening fails.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::isOpen
functions.description: Returns whether the underlying transport is open.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::peek
functions.description: Returns true if data is available either in the local read buffer or reported by the underlying transport.
requirements: Underlying transport should support peek(); may throw depending on implementation.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::close
functions.description: Flushes any pending writes (finalizing frame) and closes the underlying transport.
requirements: May throw on flush/close errors from underlying transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::readSlow
functions.description: Slow-path read for framed transport. Ensures data comes from a complete frame, reading a new frame from the underlying transport if necessary, and copies up to len bytes into buf.
requirements: buf must be writable for len bytes when len > 0.
Underlying transport must be usable/open; may block or throw.
Respects maxFrameSize_ when reading new frames; exceeding may throw (enforced in implementation).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::writeSlow
functions.description: Slow-path write when internal write buffer lacks space. Manages the frame buffer, possibly growing it; framing writes are length-prefixed on flush.
requirements: buf must be readable for len bytes when len > 0.
Underlying transport must be usable/open for eventual flush; may throw on errors.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::flush
functions.description: Finalizes the current frame by writing its 4-byte length prefix followed by the buffered payload to the underlying transport, then resets state for the next frame.
requirements: Underlying transport must be open/usable; may throw on I/O error.
Should be called to send the frame; close() calls flush() automatically.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::readEnd
functions.description: Signals end of a read message/frame for accounting; returns the number of bytes read since the start of the message (implementation-defined).
requirements: Should be paired with message/frame reads when using message-size accounting.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::writeEnd
functions.description: Signals end of a write message/frame for accounting; returns number of bytes written in the current frame (implementation-defined).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::borrowSlow
functions.description: Slow-path zero-copy borrow for framed transport. Ensures data is available from the current frame; may read a new frame. Returns pointer to contiguous buffered bytes or nullptr.
requirements: len must be non-null; on return either nullptr or at least *len bytes are available.
May block or throw depending on underlying transport and frame availability.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::getUnderlyingTransport
functions.description: Returns the wrapped underlying transport instance.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::readAll
functions.description: Inherited from TBufferBase via using-declaration; reads exactly len bytes into buf, using fast-path when possible and otherwise repeatedly reading until complete.
requirements: buf must be writable for len bytes.
May block or throw based on underlying transport behavior.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::getOrigin
functions.description: Returns the origin string from the underlying transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::setMaxFrameSize
functions.description: Sets the maximum allowed frame size for reads.
requirements: maxFrameSize must reflect an application-acceptable limit; frames larger than this will cause read to fail in implementation.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransport::getMaxFrameSize
functions.description: Returns the current maximum allowed frame size for reads.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransportFactory::TFramedTransportFactory
functions.description: Default constructor for the framed transport factory.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransportFactory::~TFramedTransportFactory
functions.description: Defaulted destructor for the framed transport factory.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFramedTransportFactory::getTransport
functions.description: Wraps the provided transport into a new TFramedTransport and returns it.
requirements: trans must be non-null and valid to be wrapped.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::TMemoryBuffer
functions.description: Constructs a TMemoryBuffer with a default-sized, owned buffer and empty contents.
requirements: config may be null.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::~TMemoryBuffer
functions.description: Destructor; frees the internal buffer only if this instance owns it.
requirements: If TAKE_OWNERSHIP was used, the memory must have been allocated with malloc as required by free().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::isOpen
functions.description: Always returns true; TMemoryBuffer has no open/close state.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::peek
functions.description: Returns true if there is readable data (rBase_ < wBase_).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::open
functions.description: No-op for memory buffer transports.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::close
functions.description: No-op for memory buffer transports.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::getBuffer
functions.description: Returns a pointer and size of the currently readable data region. Does not copy data.
requirements: bufPtr and sz must be non-null pointers.
Returned pointer is valid while the buffer remains unchanged (until reads consume data or writes modify it).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::getBufferAsString
functions.description: Returns the currently readable data as a std::string copy. Returns empty string if buffer_ is null.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::appendBufferToString
functions.description: Appends the currently readable data to the provided string without altering the buffer state.
requirements: str is a valid reference; function appends up to the readable size.
No-op if buffer_ is null.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::resetBuffer
functions.description: Resets read and write pointers to the start of the current buffer. If the buffer is not owned (OBSERVE), disables writing by setting wBound_ to wBase_ and bufferSize_ to 0.
requirements: For non-owned buffers, subsequent writes are not allowed (wBound_ == wBase_).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::readAsString
functions.description: Reads up to len bytes from the buffer and returns them as a std::string. Internally calls readAppendToString into a temporary string.
requirements: len may be greater than available; actual read amount depends on implementation of readAppendToString and may throw/limit accordingly.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::readAppendToString
functions.description: Reads up to len bytes from the buffer and appends them to str. Returns the number of bytes appended.
requirements: str is a valid reference to append to.
len is the requested maximum to read; must fit in uint32_t.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::readEnd
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes read since the start of the message (rBase_ - buffer_), resets buffer to empty if fully consumed, and resets consumed message size accounting.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::writeEnd
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes written since the buffer base (wBase_ - buffer_).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::available_read
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read (wBase_ - rBase_).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::available_write
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes available to write (wBound_ - wBase_).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::getWritePtr
functions.description: Ensures at least len bytes of space are available for writing and returns a pointer to the start of the writable region for direct writes. The caller must call wroteBytes(lenWritten) after writing.
requirements: len is the number of bytes the caller intends to write; buffer will be grown if needed up to maxBufferSize_.
Caller must call wroteBytes() with the exact number of bytes actually written to keep state consistent.
May throw on allocation failure or if growth would exceed maxBufferSize_.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::wroteBytes
functions.description: Notifies the buffer that len bytes have been written into the memory returned by getWritePtr(), advancing the write pointer.
requirements: len must not exceed the space previously ensured by getWritePtr().
getWritePtr() must have been called to obtain writable space prior to wroteBytes().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::readAll
functions.description: Uses TBufferBase::readAll to read exactly len bytes from the memory buffer into buf.
requirements: buf must be writable for len bytes.
If fewer than len bytes are available, behavior follows readAll (may block in other transports, but here will read what is available or throw per implementation).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::getBufferSize
functions.description: Returns the current allocated buffer size in bytes.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::getMaxBufferSize
functions.description: Returns the current maximum buffer size limit.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TMemoryBuffer::setMaxBufferSize
functions.description: Sets the maximum buffer size limit. Throws BAD_ARGS if the new maximum is less than the current buffer size.
requirements: maxSize must be greater than or equal to the current buffer size, otherwise throws TTransportException(BAD_ARGS).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::TSocket
functions.description: Constructs an unconnected TCP/Unix-domain socket transport using the provided (optional) TConfiguration. Does not connect; call open() to establish a connection.
requirements: No connection is attempted by the constructor; callers must invoke open() before read/write unless they set a connected file descriptor separately.
config may be null; if provided, it must remain valid for the lifetime of the TSocket.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::~TSocket
functions.description: Destructor that cleans up the socket transport, closing the underlying socket if necessary.
requirements: After destruction, the underlying socket descriptor must no longer be used by the caller.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::isOpen
functions.description: Returns whether the socket is currently open (alive).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::peek
functions.description: Blocks until at least one byte is available to read or until the socket is closed, then reports whether data is available.
requirements: The call may block until data is available or the socket is closed.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::open
functions.description: Creates and opens the socket connection (TCP or Unix domain depending on configuration).
requirements: May throw TTransportException if the socket cannot connect.
For TCP, a host and port should have been set via constructor or setters before calling open() (inferred from design).
For Unix domain sockets, a path should have been set via constructor or setPath() before calling open() (inferred from design).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::close
functions.description: Shuts down communication on the socket and closes the underlying descriptor.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::hasPendingDataToRead
functions.description: Non-blocking check for whether there is pending data available to read on the socket.
requirements: Must handle TTransportException where NOT_OPEN indicates the socket has been closed and UNKNOWN indicates an unexpected error (per comment).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::read
functions.signature: virtual uint32_t read(uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len)
functions.description: Reads up to len bytes from the socket into buf. Returns the number of bytes read; a return value of 0 indicates EOF.
requirements: buf must be a valid writable pointer when len > 0.
len may be 0 to perform a no-op read (inferred from standard practice).
Socket must be open before calling (inferred from transport semantics).
May throw TTransportException with types: INTERRUPTED (interrupted out of a blocking call), NOT_OPEN (socket closed), TIMED_OUT (receive timeout expired), UNKNOWN (unexpected error).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::write
functions.signature: virtual void write(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len)
functions.description: Writes len bytes to the socket, looping internally until all data is sent or an error occurs.
requirements: buf must be a valid readable pointer when len > 0.
Socket should be open before calling (inferred from transport semantics).
On failure, expect an exception consistent with TTransport write errors (inferred; not explicitly documented here).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::write_partial
functions.signature: virtual uint32_t write_partial(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t len)
functions.description: Performs a single send() call to write up to len bytes and returns the number of bytes actually written without looping.
requirements: buf must be a valid readable pointer when len > 0.
Socket should be open before calling (inferred from transport semantics).
Caller must handle partial writes by inspecting the return value and possibly retrying.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getHost
functions.description: Returns the configured remote host name or address for TCP sockets.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getPort
functions.description: Returns the configured remote TCP port.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getPath
functions.description: Returns the configured Unix domain socket path.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::isUnixDomainSocket
functions.description: Returns true if the socket is configured as a Unix domain socket (i.e., path is not empty).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setHost
functions.description: Sets the target host name or address for a TCP connection.
requirements: host is a hostname or IP literal string (inferred).
Effect takes place on subsequent open() calls; it does not change an already-open connection (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setPort
functions.description: Sets the target TCP port for the connection.
requirements: port should be in the range 0–65535 (inferred from standard socket API).
Effect takes place on subsequent open() calls; it does not change an already-open connection (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setPath
functions.description: Sets the Unix domain socket path to use for the connection.
requirements: On Linux, a leading '\0' in path selects an abstract namespace socket (per comment).
Effect takes place on subsequent open() calls; it does not change an already-open connection (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setLinger
functions.description: Enables or disables SO_LINGER and sets the linger timeout in seconds when enabled.
requirements: If on is true, linger should be a non-negative number of seconds (inferred from SO_LINGER semantics).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setNoDelay
functions.description: Enables or disables Nagle’s algorithm (TCP_NODELAY).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setConnTimeout
functions.description: Sets the connection timeout in milliseconds.
requirements: ms should be non-negative (inferred from timeout semantics).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setRecvTimeout
functions.description: Sets the receive timeout in milliseconds.
requirements: ms should be non-negative (inferred from timeout semantics).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setSendTimeout
functions.description: Sets the send timeout in milliseconds.
requirements: ms should be non-negative (inferred from timeout semantics).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setMaxRecvRetries
functions.description: Sets the maximum number of recv retries in case of a THRIFT_EAGAIN error.
requirements: maxRecvRetries should be non-negative (inferred from retry semantics).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setKeepAlive
functions.description: Enables or disables SO_KEEPALIVE on the socket.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getSocketInfo
functions.description: Returns a formatted string containing socket information, typically including host and port.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getPeerHost
functions.description: Returns the DNS name of the remote peer to which the socket is connected.
requirements: Meaningful only when the socket is connected; otherwise the value may be empty or unspecified (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getPeerAddress
functions.description: Returns the address (IP) of the remote peer to which the socket is connected.
requirements: Meaningful only when the socket is connected; otherwise the value may be empty or unspecified (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getPeerPort
functions.description: Returns the port number of the remote peer to which the socket is connected.
requirements: Meaningful only when the socket is connected; otherwise the value may be unspecified (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getSocketFD
functions.description: Returns the underlying socket file descriptor for this transport.
requirements: The returned descriptor should not be closed or modified by the caller while the TSocket owns it (inferred from ownership patterns).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setSocketFD
functions.description: Re-initializes the TSocket to use the supplied socket descriptor. Intended primarily for internal/server use (e.g., TNonblockingServer).
requirements: fd must be a descriptor for an already-connected socket (per comment).
Primarily intended for TNonblockingServer; other use may lead to unexpected behavior (per comment).
Caller must ensure fd is not simultaneously owned/managed elsewhere.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getCachedAddress
functions.description: Returns a cached copy of the peer address and sets *len to its length, if available. Only IPv4 and IPv6 are cached.
requirements: len must be a non-null pointer to receive the address length (inferred from signature).
Returned pointer refers to internal cached storage; its lifetime is managed by TSocket (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setUseLowMinRto
functions.description: Globally sets whether to use a low minimum TCP retransmission timeout for sockets created by this transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getUseLowMinRto
functions.description: Returns whether a low minimum TCP retransmission timeout is enabled globally for this transport.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::getOrigin
functions.description: Returns a string that identifies the origin the socket is connected to, combining peer host and port.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocket::setCachedAddress
functions.signature: void setCachedAddress(const sockaddr* addr, socklen_t len)
functions.description: Sets an internal cache of the peer address when trivially available (e.g., after accept() or connect()). Only caches IPv4 and IPv6; unsets the cache for other families.
requirements: addr must point to a valid sockaddr structure of family AF_INET or AF_INET6 to be cached; for other families, the cache will be unset (per comment).
len must match the size of the supplied sockaddr structure (inferred from standard socket API).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::TServerSocket
functions.description: Constructs a server transport bound to the given TCP port. Used to set up a listening server socket later via listen().
requirements: port: valid TCP port number (typically 0-65535). Exact constraints not documented.
Further binding occurs in listen(); constructor does not imply the socket is listening.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::~TServerSocket
functions.description: Destructor for the server transport. Cleans up resources associated with the listening socket and any internal descriptors.
requirements: No explicit requirements documented; object should not be used after destruction.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::isOpen
functions.description: Returns whether the server transport is open (i.e., has an active underlying socket).
requirements: None documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setSendTimeout
functions.description: Sets the send timeout to be applied to accepted child sockets created by this server.
requirements: sendTimeout: integer timeout value; units not explicitly documented (commonly milliseconds in Thrift).
No ordering requirement documented relative to listen().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setRecvTimeout
functions.description: Sets the receive timeout to be applied to accepted child sockets created by this server.
requirements: recvTimeout: integer timeout value; units not explicitly documented (commonly milliseconds in Thrift).
No ordering requirement documented relative to listen().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setAcceptTimeout
functions.description: Sets the accept() timeout for the listening socket, controlling how long accept blocks.
requirements: accTimeout: integer timeout value; units not explicitly documented.
No ordering requirement documented relative to listen().

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setAcceptBacklog
functions.description: Sets the listen backlog size to be used when placing the socket in listening state.
requirements: accBacklog: non-negative integer backlog. Exact valid range not documented.
No ordering requirement documented, but backlog typically applies at listen time.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setRetryLimit
functions.description: Sets the number of times the server will retry certain operations (e.g., transient accept/bind failures). Exact semantics not documented.
requirements: retryLimit: non-negative integer. Exact interpretation not documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setRetryDelay
functions.description: Sets the delay between retries for operations controlled by retryLimit. Exact units not documented.
requirements: retryDelay: non-negative integer delay; units not explicitly documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setKeepAlive
functions.description: Enables or disables SO_KEEPALIVE on accepted sockets.
requirements: keepAlive: true to enable TCP keepalive, false to disable.
No ordering requirement documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setTcpSendBuffer
functions.description: Sets the TCP send buffer size to be applied to sockets created by this server.
requirements: tcpSendBuffer: positive integer buffer size in bytes (units inferred from typical TCP semantics; not explicitly documented).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setTcpRecvBuffer
functions.description: Sets the TCP receive buffer size to be applied to sockets created by this server.
requirements: tcpRecvBuffer: positive integer buffer size in bytes (units inferred from typical TCP semantics; not explicitly documented).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setListenCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked just before listen(), after Thrift has applied its setsockopt() options to the listening socket. Use to apply additional socket options to the listening socket.
requirements: listenCallback must be callable with a THRIFT_SOCKET (the listening socket FD).
Callback should be safe to run in the context where listen() is called.
If no callback is needed, pass an empty std::function.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setAcceptCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked after each accept() on the newly created client socket, after Thrift has applied its setsockopt() options. Use to apply additional options to accepted sockets.
requirements: acceptCallback must be callable with a THRIFT_SOCKET (the accepted socket FD).
Callback should be safe to run in the accept path.
If no callback is needed, pass an empty std::function.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::setInterruptableChildren
functions.description: Controls whether child TSockets created by accept() are constructed to support interruption via TServerTransport::interruptChildren(). Enabling adds a poll() overhead but allows clean shutdowns.
requirements: Must be called before listen(); mode cannot be switched after that.
May throw std::logic_error if listen() has already been called (per comment).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::getSocketFD
functions.description: Returns the underlying listening socket file descriptor (or equivalent handle on non-POSIX).
requirements: None documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::getPort
functions.description: Returns the configured port number for INET/INET6 sockets.
requirements: Meaningful for INET/INET6 sockets; for UNIX domain sockets the value may be undefined/not meaningful (not documented).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::getPath
functions.description: Returns the filesystem path for UNIX domain sockets.
requirements: Meaningful only when using a UNIX domain socket configuration.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::isUnixDomainSocket
functions.description: Indicates whether this server socket is configured as a UNIX domain socket.
requirements: None documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::listen
functions.description: Binds the server socket (if necessary), applies socket options, invokes the optional listen callback, and starts listening for connections.
requirements: If setInterruptableChildren() must be used, call it before listen() (per comment on setInterruptableChildren).
No other explicit preconditions documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::interrupt
functions.description: Interrupts the listening server socket so that blocking accept/select/poll can be unblocked, facilitating shutdown.
requirements: No explicit requirements documented; typically used while another thread is blocked in accept/listen loop.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::interruptChildren
functions.description: Interrupts child TSockets created by this server (when interruptableChildren is enabled) to facilitate server shutdown.
requirements: Effective only when child sockets were created with interrupt support (set via setInterruptableChildren(true) before listen()).
No other explicit requirements documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TServerSocket::close
functions.description: Closes the listening server socket and associated resources.
requirements: Safe to call to release resources; behavior on repeated calls is not documented.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPoolServer::TSocketPoolServer
functions.description: Default constructor for a server record used by TSocketPool. Initializes an empty server descriptor with default values (host, port, and failure tracking).
requirements: No arguments required.
Resulting object should be populated (host/port) before being used in a pool.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPoolServer::TSocketPoolServer
functions.description: Constructs a server record with the specified host and port for use in a TSocketPool.
requirements: host should be a valid hostname or IP address string (inferred).
port must be a valid TCP port number in the range 1–65535 (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::TSocketPool
functions.description: Creates an empty TCP socket pool transport. Servers can be added later via addServer or setServers before opening the transport.
requirements: Before calling open(), at least one server should be configured (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::TSocketPool
functions.description: Constructs a socket pool from parallel vectors of hostnames and ports.
requirements: hosts.size() must equal ports.size() (inferred from parallel lists).
Each host should be a valid hostname or IP address string (inferred).
Each port must be a valid TCP port number in the range 1–65535 (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::TSocketPool
functions.description: Constructs a socket pool from a list of (host, port) pairs.
requirements: Each host should be a valid hostname or IP address string (inferred).
Each port must be a valid TCP port number in the range 1–65535 (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::TSocketPool
functions.description: Constructs a socket pool from a list of TSocketPoolServer descriptors.
requirements: Each shared_ptr in servers should be non-null (inferred).
Each contained server should have a valid host and port set (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::TSocketPool
functions.description: Constructs a socket pool initialized with a single server.
requirements: host should be a valid hostname or IP address string (inferred).
port must be a valid TCP port number in the range 1–65535 (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::~TSocketPool
functions.description: Destructor for the socket pool. Closes the socket if necessary and releases resources.
requirements: None for callers; it is safe to destroy an instance when it is no longer in use.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::addServer
functions.description: Adds a server (host, port) to the pool’s server list.
requirements: host should be a valid hostname or IP address string (inferred).
port must be a valid TCP port number in the range 1–65535 (inferred).
Should be called before open() to take effect for the initial connection attempt (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::addServer
functions.description: Adds an existing TSocketPoolServer descriptor to the pool.
requirements: server should be a non-null shared_ptr (inferred).
server should contain a valid host and port (inferred).
Should be called before open() to take effect for the initial connection attempt (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::setServers
functions.description: Replaces the pool’s server list with the provided list of server descriptors.
requirements: Each shared_ptr in servers should be non-null (inferred).
Each server should contain a valid host and port (inferred).
If servers is empty, open() will have no servers to attempt (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::getServers
functions.description: Retrieves the current list of servers in the pool into the provided vector reference.
requirements: Callers must pass a reference to a vector that can be modified; any existing contents may be overwritten or appended depending on implementation (unknown exact behavior).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::setNumRetries
functions.description: Sets how many times the pool should retry connecting to a host during open().
requirements: numRetries should be >= 0 (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::setRetryInterval
functions.description: Sets the retry interval in seconds before retrying a host that has been marked down.
requirements: retryInterval should be >= 0 seconds (inferred).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TSocketPool::setMaxConsecutiveFailures
functions.description: Sets the number of consecutive connection failures before a host is marked as down.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::THttpClient::THttpClient

functions.description: Constructs an HTTP client transport that wraps an existing transport and sets HTTP header fields for Host and request path. requirements: Should be called only when the underlying transport is initialized and open (inferred from transport usage)

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::THttpTransport::~THttpTransport
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the HTTP transport base. Ensures proper cleanup through base pointers and derived classes.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFDTransport::TFDTransport
functions.description: Constructs a TFDTransport that wraps an existing file descriptor. requirements: fd must be a valid (>= 0) OS file descriptor that is already open at construction time.

functions.description: Destructor for TFDTransport. If the ClosePolicy is CLOSE_ON_DESTROY, it attempts to close the wrapped file descriptor. Any TTransportException thrown by close() is caught and logged via TOutput.
requirements: If ClosePolicy is CLOSE_ON_DESTROY, callers must assume the underlying file descriptor will be closed during destruction and must not use it afterward.

functions.description: Closes the wrapped file descriptor. Intended to release the OS resource associated with the transport. The destructor calls this when ClosePolicy is CLOSE_ON_DESTROY.
requirements: May throw TTransportException on failure (inferred from destructor catching it); callers should be prepared to handle exceptions.
After successful close(), the transport should be considered not open (fd_ will no longer be usable).
Should only be called when a valid descriptor is wrapped; behavior is undefined if no valid descriptor was set.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFDTransport::read
functions.description: Reads up to len bytes from the wrapped file descriptor into buf and returns the number of bytes read. This is a thin wrapper around OS read semantics for the underlying descriptor.
requirements: buf must be a valid, writable pointer to a buffer of at least len bytes when len > 0.
len may be zero; if zero, no bytes are read and the call should be a no-op returning 0 (standard convention; exact behavior not documented).
The transport must wrap a valid, open file descriptor; calling read() on a closed/invalid fd will fail and may throw a TTransportException.
Callers should be prepared for short reads and potential blocking depending on the descriptor mode (blocking/nonblocking) — precise behavior is not documented here.

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFDTransport::write
functions.description: Writes len bytes from buf to the wrapped file descriptor. This is a thin wrapper around OS write semantics for the underlying descriptor.
requirements: buf must be a valid, readable pointer to at least len bytes when len > 0.
len may be zero; if zero, no data is written (standard convention; exact behavior not documented).
The transport must wrap a valid, open file descriptor; calling write() on a closed/invalid fd will fail and may throw a TTransportException.
Callers should be prepared for partial writes and potential blocking depending on the descriptor mode — precise behavior is not documented here.

functions.description: Sets/replaces the wrapped file descriptor used by the transport.

If a previous descriptor was set and ClosePolicy is CLOSE_ON_DESTROY, the previous descriptor will only be closed on destruction (not automatically on replacement) — exact behavior is not specified; callers should manage lifetimes accordingly.
Should not be called concurrently with I/O on the same transport (thread-safety not specified).

functions.name: apache::thrift::transport::TFDTransport::getFD

functions.name: TFileTransportBuffer::TFileTransportBuffer
functions.description: Constructs a bounded in-memory FIFO buffer that stores pointers to eventInfo objects for later writing to disk. functions.description: Dequeue and return the next eventInfo pointer during the read phase. Returns nullptr when the buffer becomes empty or if called in an inappropriate phase (implementation-specific; not specified here).

Caller is responsible for handling a nullptr return indicating no more events

functions.description: Resets the buffer state so it can be reused for another write → read cycle. Must be called before writing again after a read phase.
requirements: Call reset() before attempting to write to the buffer again after any reads have occurred (per class documentation)
